script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

EXT. CENTRAL PARK - DAY

A picturesque scene of CENTRAL PARK in FALL. Leaves in vibrant hues of orange and red flutter down, dancing on the wind.

INT. STARBUCKS - DAY

JAMES, a bookish and earnest man, sits across from EMMA, a carefree and vivacious woman. Both sip their coffees.

EMMA
(smiling)
So, what's the plan for today?

JAMES
(nervously)
Well, I thought we could visit the new art exhibit downtown.

EMMA
(surprised)
Really? Art? I didn't know you were into that.

JAMES
(smiling)
I've always had an appreciation for it. You, on the other hand, are a force of nature.

EMMA
(laughs)
Flatterer! I'll have to keep that in mind.

INT. CENTRAL PARK - DAY

They stroll through the park, chatting about art, life, and dreams. The sun casts a warm glow upon them.

EMMA
(pointing at a sculpture)
What do you think about this one?

JAMES
It's... powerful. I can see the emotion in the artist's handiwork.

EMMA
(smiling)
That's what I love about art. It's a window into another person's soul.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - NIGHT

They sit in the dimly lit coffee shop, laughing and sharing stories.

JAMES
(leaning in)
Emma, I've enjoyed every moment we've spent together. I feel like I've known you forever.

EMMA
(giggling)
And I feel the same way about you, James.

They share a heartfelt moment, their eyes locked in a comfortable silence.

EXT. CENTRAL PARK - NIGHT

They walk through the park under the stars, their laughter echoing off the trees.

EMMA
(looking at the sky)
It's beautiful, isn't it?

JAMES
(nodding)
It is. And so are you.

EMMA
(smiling)
Aww, James. You're something else.

INT. JAMES' APARTMENT - NIGHT

They sit on the couch, watching an old movie. James puts his arm around Emma, and they share a comfortable silence.

EMMA
(leaning her head on James' shoulder)
This has been the best day ever.

JAMES
(smiling)
I'm glad you feel that way, Emma. I wouldn't want it any other way.

INT. KITCHEN - DAY

They cook a simple meal together, laughing and joking as they chop vegetables and stir pots.

EMMA
(pouring wine)
To us and our friendship.

JAMES
(raising his glass)
To us.

They clink glasses and take a sip, sharing a loving smile.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

They sit on the couch, wrapped in a cozy blanket, watching the sun set through the window.

EMMA
(snuggling closer to James)
You know, I've never felt this connected to anyone before.

JAMES
(looking into her eyes)
And I've never felt this way about anyone else.

They share a long, passionate kiss, their hearts beating in sync.

FADE OUT.

END OF SCREENPLAY.
